## Data Process
```{r}
data$Standarlized_Identity <- as.factor(data$Shape_Standardized_Identity)

## 排除被试存在某个Identity正确率低于50%

subjects_to_exclude <- data %>%
  group_by(Subject, Shape_Standardized_Identity) %>%
  summarise(mean_acc = mean(ACC, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(mean_acc < 0.5) %>%
  distinct(Subject)

# 排除这些被试
data_filtered <- data %>%
  anti_join(subjects_to_exclude, by = "Subject")

unique(data$Source)

levels(data_mat$Standarlized_Identity)

data_mat <- filter(data_filtered, Matching == 'Matching', RT_ms >= 200, RT_ms <= 5000)

unique(data_mat$Subject)

data_RT_mat <- filter(data_mat, ACC == 1, RT_ms >= 200, RT_ms <= 5000)

data_RT_mat$log_RT_ms <- log(data_RT_mat$RT_ms)
```

```{r}
# 简单的科恩d计算函数
cohens_d_simple_RT <- function(x, y) {
  if (length(x) < 2 | length(y) < 2) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  mean_diff <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)
  n1 <- length(x)
  n2 <- length(y)
  var1 <- var(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  var2 <- var(y, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * var1 + (n2 - 1) * var2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
  
  return(mean_diff / pooled_sd)
}
```

```{r}
# 修改后的主计算函数 - 保存source列
calculate_cohens_d_simple <- function(data) {
  
  # 检查数据中是否有Source列
  if (!"Source" %in% colnames(data)) {
    stop("数据中没有找到'Source'列")
  }
  
  # 获取所有被试
  subjects <- unique(data$Subject)
  
  # 获取除Self外的所有身份类别
  other_identities <- setdiff(unique(data$Standarlized_Identity), "Self")
  
  # 创建结果存储
  results <- data.frame()
  
  # 对每个被试进行循环
  for (subj in subjects) {
    
    # 获取该被试的数据
    subj_data <- data[data$Subject == subj, ]
    
    # 获取该被试的Source信息（直接从Source列获取）
    subject_source <- subj_data$Source[1]  # 取第一个非NA值
    
    # 获取Self数据
    self_RT <- subj_data$log_RT_ms[subj_data$Standarlized_Identity == "Self"]
    
    # 如果没有Self数据，跳过
    if (length(self_RT) == 0) {
      next
    }
    
    # 对每个其他身份类别计算科恩d
    for (identity in other_identities) {
      
      # 获取该身份类别的数据
      other_RT <- subj_data$log_RT_ms[subj_data$Standarlized_Identity == identity]
      
      # 计算科恩d
      if (length(other_RT) > 0) {
        d_value <- cohens_d_simple_RT(other_RT, self_RT)
        effect_size <- ifelse(is.na(d_value), "No data",
                              ifelse(abs(d_value) < 0.2, "Negligible",
                                     ifelse(abs(d_value) < 0.5, "Small",
                                            ifelse(abs(d_value) < 0.8, "Medium", "Large"))))
      } else {
        d_value <- NA
        effect_size <- "No data"
      }
      
      # 添加到结果中
      temp_result <- data.frame(
        Source = subject_source,  # 直接使用数据中的Source列
        Subject = subj,
        Identity = identity,
        Cohens_d = d_value,
        n_Self = length(self_RT),
        n_Other = length(other_RT),
        Effect_Size = effect_size,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      results <- rbind(results, temp_result)
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
# ACC
# 简单的科恩d计算函数 (Self - 其他身份)
cohens_d_simple_ACC <- function(x, y) {
  # x = Self身份类别的ACC值
  # y = 其他身份类别的ACC值
  
  if (length(x) < 2 | length(y) < 2) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  mean_diff <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE) - mean(y, na.rm = TRUE)  # Self - 其他身份
  n1 <- length(x)
  n2 <- length(y)
  var1 <- var(x, na.rm = TRUE)
  var2 <- var(y, na.rm = TRUE)
  
  pooled_sd <- sqrt(((n1 - 1) * var1 + (n2 - 1) * var2) / (n1 + n2 - 2))
  
  return(mean_diff / pooled_sd)
}

```

```{r}
# 主计算函数 - 简化版 (Self - 其他身份)
calculate_cohens_d_simple_ACC <- function(data) {
  
  # 获取所有被试
  subjects <- unique(data$Subject)
  
  # 获取除Self外的所有身份类别
  other_identities <- setdiff(unique(data$Standarlized_Identity), "Self")
  
  # 创建结果存储
  results <- data.frame()
  
  # 对每个被试进行循环
  for (subj in subjects) {
    
    # 获取该被试的数据
    subj_data <- data[data$Subject == subj, ]
    
    # 获取该被试的Source信息（直接从Source列获取）
    subject_source <- subj_data$Source[1]  # 取第一个非NA值
    
    # 获取Self数据
    self_acc <- subj_data$ACC[subj_data$Standarlized_Identity == "Self"]
    
    # 如果没有Self数据，跳过
    if (length(self_acc) == 0) {
      next
    }
    
    # 对每个其他身份类别计算科恩d
    for (identity in other_identities) {
      
      # 获取该身份类别的数据
      other_acc <- subj_data$ACC[subj_data$Standarlized_Identity == identity]
      
      # 计算科恩d (注意：这里改为 self_acc, other_acc 的顺序)
      if (length(other_acc) > 0) {
        d_value <- cohens_d_simple_ACC(self_acc, other_acc)  # Self - 其他身份
        effect_size <- ifelse(is.na(d_value), "No data",
                              ifelse(abs(d_value) < 0.2, "Negligible",
                                     ifelse(abs(d_value) < 0.5, "Small",
                                            ifelse(abs(d_value) < 0.8, "Medium", "Large"))))
      } else {
        d_value <- NA
        effect_size <- "No data"
      }
      
      # 添加到结果中
      temp_result <- data.frame(
        Source = subject_source,  # 直接使用数据中的Source列
        Subject = subj,
        Identity = identity,
        Cohens_d = d_value,
        n_Self = length(self_acc),
        n_Other = length(other_acc),
        Effect_Size = effect_size,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      results <- rbind(results, temp_result)
    }
  }
  
  return(results)
}

```

```{r}
#  RT雨云图 
p_RT_raincloud <- ggplot(cohens_d_results_RT, aes(x = Identity, y = Cohens_d, fill = Identity, colour = Identity)) +
  # 半眼图（密度分布）- 更平滑
  stat_halfeye(
    adjust = 1.3,        # 平滑度 
    width = 0.6, 
    .width = 0, 
    justification = -0.2, 
    point_colour = NA
  ) +
  # 箱线图 - 黑色边框
  geom_boxplot(
    aes(x = as.numeric(as.factor(Identity)) + 0.1, y = Cohens_d), # 更靠近散点
    outlier.shape = NA, 
    alpha = 0.5, 
    width = 0.1, 
    colour = "gray",    # 黑色边框
    size = 0.8
  ) + 
  # 散点图 - 更靠近箱线图
  geom_point(
    aes(x = as.numeric(as.factor(Identity)) - 0.1, y = Cohens_d, fill = Identity), # 保持颜色
    size = 2, 
    alpha = 0.6, 
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.04),  # 减少抖动
    shape = 21           # 可设置填充和边框的形状
  ) +
  # 零线
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
  # 颜色设置
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors_manual) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = custom_colors_manual) +
  # 坐标系
  coord_flip() +  # 翻转坐标轴
  # 标签
  labs(
    y = "Cohen's d (Other - Self Identity)",
    x = "Identity Category"
  ) +
  # 主题
  theme_cowplot() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
```

## Check
```{r}
################

# 查看结果汇总
summarize_results <- function(results) {
  
  # 按身份类别汇总
  summary_by_identity <- results %>%
    filter(!is.na(Cohens_d)) %>%
    group_by(Identity) %>%
    summarise(
      n_subjects = n(),
      mean_d = round(mean(Cohens_d, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      sd_d = round(sd(Cohens_d, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      median_d = round(median(Cohens_d, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      min_d = round(min(Cohens_d, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      max_d = round(max(Cohens_d, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(mean_d)))
  
  return(summary_by_identity)
}
```

```{r}
# 计算cohens_d值的差异
# 计算RT

Cohend_RT <- lme4::lmer(data = cohens_d_results_RT, 
                        formula = Cohens_d ~ Identity + (1|Subject) + (1|Source),
                        control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

saveRDS(Cohend_RT, file = "Cohend_RT.rds")

Cohend_ACC <- lme4::lmer(data = cohens_d_results_ACC, 
                         formula = Cohens_d ~ Identity + (1|Subject) + (1|Source),
                         control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

saveRDS(Cohend_ACC, file = "Cohend_ACC.rds")

Cohend_RT_2 <- lme4::lmer(data = cohens_d_results_RT, 
                          formula = Cohens_d ~ Identity + (1|Subject) ,
                          control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

Cohend_ACC_2 <- lme4::lmer(data = cohens_d_results_ACC, 
                           formula = Cohens_d ~ Identity + (1|Subject) ,
                           control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

emm_options(pbkrtest.limit = 100000)
Cohend_RT <- as_lmerModLmerTest(Cohend_RT)
summary(Cohend_RT)

EMM_Cohend_RT <- emmeans(Cohend_RT, pairwise~Identity, adjust = "BH")       #对Shape不同水平下进行两两比较

Cohend_ACC <- as_lmerModLmerTest(Cohend_ACC)
summary(Cohend_ACC)
EMM_Cohend_ACC <- emmeans(Cohend_ACC, pairwise~Identity, adjust = "BH")   #对TrialType不同水平下进行两两比较
```

## CI draw
```{r}
################## 
# 个条件系数计算
fixed_coefs <- fixef(Cohend_RT)
vcov_matrix <- vcov(Cohend_RT)

print("固定效应系数:")
print(fixed_coefs)
print("方差协方差矩阵:")
print(vcov_matrix)

# 2. 从多元正态分布中抽样系数
n_samples <- 10000  # 抽样次数
sampled_coefs <- mvrnorm(n_samples, mu = fixed_coefs, Sigma = vcov_matrix)

# 3. 计算每个身份类别的分布
# 获取截距列
intercept_samples <- sampled_coefs[, "(Intercept)"]

# 根据你的模型调整这些列名
stranger_samples <- intercept_samples + sampled_coefs[, "IdentityStranger"]
nonperson_samples <- intercept_samples + sampled_coefs[, "IdentityNonPerson"]
close_samples <- intercept_samples + sampled_coefs[, "IdentityClose"]
celebrity_samples <- intercept_samples + sampled_coefs[, "IdentityCelebrity"]
acquaintance_samples <- intercept_samples

# 置信区间
# Stranger的置信区间
stranger_ci <- quantile(stranger_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
stranger_mean <- mean(stranger_samples)

# NonPerson的置信区间
nonperson_ci <- quantile(nonperson_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
nonperson_mean <- mean(nonperson_samples)

# Close的置信区间
close_ci <- quantile(close_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
close_mean <- mean(close_samples)

# Celebrity的置信区间
celebrity_ci <- quantile(celebrity_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
celebrity_mean <- mean(celebrity_samples)

# Acquaintance的置信区间
acquaintance_ci <- quantile(acquaintance_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
acquaintance_mean <- mean(acquaintance_samples)

# 4. 创建绘图数据框
distribution_data <- data.frame(
  Identity = c(rep("Stranger", n_samples),
               rep("NonPerson", n_samples),
               rep("Close", n_samples),
               rep("Celebrity", n_samples),
               rep("Acquaintance", n_samples)),
  Predicted_Value = c(stranger_samples, nonperson_samples, 
                      close_samples, celebrity_samples, acquaintance_samples),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print("分布数据前几行:")
print(head(distribution_data))

# 5. 设置颜色
custom_colors_manual <- c(
  "NonPerson" = rgb(219, 49, 36, maxColorValue = 255),   # 红色
  "Stranger" = rgb(252, 140, 90, maxColorValue = 255),     # 橙色  
  "Celebrity" = rgb(255, 223, 146, maxColorValue = 255),        # 黄色
  "Acquaintance" = rgb(144, 190, 224, maxColorValue = 255),    # 浅蓝色
  "Close" = rgb(75, 116, 178, maxColorValue = 255)       # 深蓝色
)


# 计算各身份类别的置信区间和均值（代码保持不变）
stranger_ci <- quantile(stranger_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
stranger_mean <- mean(stranger_samples)
nonperson_ci <- quantile(nonperson_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
nonperson_mean <- mean(nonperson_samples)
close_ci <- quantile(close_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
close_mean <- mean(close_samples)
celebrity_ci <- quantile(celebrity_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
celebrity_mean <- mean(celebrity_samples)
acquaintance_ci <- quantile(acquaintance_samples, c(0.025, 0.975))
acquaintance_mean <- mean(acquaintance_samples)

# 创建分布数据框（代码保持不变）
distribution_data <- data.frame(
  Identity = c(rep("Stranger", n_samples),
               rep("NonPerson", n_samples),
               rep("Close", n_samples),
               rep("Celebrity", n_samples),
               rep("Acquaintance", n_samples)),
  Predicted_Value = c(stranger_samples, nonperson_samples, 
                      close_samples, celebrity_samples, acquaintance_samples),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 创建置信区间数据框（代码保持不变）
ci_data <- data.frame(
  Identity = c("Stranger", "NonPerson", "Close", "Celebrity", "Acquaintance"),
  Mean = c(stranger_mean, nonperson_mean, close_mean, celebrity_mean, acquaintance_mean),
  CI_lower = c(stranger_ci[1], nonperson_ci[1], close_ci[1], celebrity_ci[1], acquaintance_ci[1]),
  CI_upper = c(stranger_ci[2], nonperson_ci[2], close_ci[2], celebrity_ci[2], acquaintance_ci[2]),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

print("置信区间数据:")
print(ci_data)
```

### Draw Pic -v2(可运行)
```{r}
# ============================================
# 从混合线性模型生成Ridge图的数据
# ============================================
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)
library(MASS)  # for mvrnorm
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)

# 假设已经运行了以下代码创建模型：
Cohend_RT <- lme4::lmer(data = cohens_d_results_RT,
                        formula = Cohens_d ~ Identity + (1|Subject) + (1|Source),
                        control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))
Cohend_ACC <- lme4::lmer(data = cohens_d_results_ACC,
                         formula = Cohens_d ~ Identity + (1|Subject) + (1|Source),
                         control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

# 第一部分: RT模型
# ============================================
# 1. 从RT模型中提取参数
fixed_coefs_RT <- fixef(Cohend_RT)
vcov_matrix_RT <- vcov(Cohend_RT)
random_effects_RT <- VarCorr(Cohend_RT)
sigma_subject_RT <- attr(random_effects_RT$Subject, "stddev")
sigma_source_RT <- attr(random_effects_RT$Source, "stddev")
sigma_residual_RT <- sigma(Cohend_RT)

print("=== RT模型参数 ===")
print("固定效应:")
print(fixed_coefs_RT)
print(paste("Subject随机效应SD:", round(sigma_subject_RT, 3)))
print(paste("Source随机效应SD:", round(sigma_source_RT, 3)))
print(paste("残差SD:", round(sigma_residual_RT, 3)))

# 2. 生成模拟数据
n_samples <- 10000

# 从多元正态分布抽样固定效应
sampled_coefs_RT <- mvrnorm(n_samples, mu = fixed_coefs_RT, Sigma = vcov_matrix_RT)

# 计算各身份类别的固定效应
intercept_RT <- sampled_coefs_RT[, "(Intercept)"]
stranger_fixed_RT <- intercept_RT + sampled_coefs_RT[, "IdentityStranger"]
nonperson_fixed_RT <- intercept_RT + sampled_coefs_RT[, "IdentityNonPerson"]
close_fixed_RT <- intercept_RT + sampled_coefs_RT[, "IdentityClose"]
celebrity_fixed_RT <- intercept_RT + sampled_coefs_RT[, "IdentityCelebrity"]
acquaintance_fixed_RT <- intercept_RT

# 3. 选项A: 只用固定效应生成密度图数据
distribution_data_RT_fixed <- data.frame(
  Identity = rep(c("NonPerson", "Stranger", "Celebrity", "Acquaintance", "Close"), each = n_samples),
  Predicted_Value = c(nonperson_fixed_RT, stranger_fixed_RT, celebrity_fixed_RT, 
                      acquaintance_fixed_RT, close_fixed_RT)
)

# 4. 选项B: 包含随机效应生成密度图数据
total_sd_RT <- sqrt(sigma_subject_RT^2 + sigma_source_RT^2 + sigma_residual_RT^2)
print(paste("RT总体SD(含所有随机效应):", round(total_sd_RT, 3)))

stranger_pred_RT <- stranger_fixed_RT + rnorm(n_samples, 0, total_sd_RT)
nonperson_pred_RT <- nonperson_fixed_RT + rnorm(n_samples, 0, total_sd_RT)
close_pred_RT <- close_fixed_RT + rnorm(n_samples, 0, total_sd_RT)
celebrity_pred_RT <- celebrity_fixed_RT + rnorm(n_samples, 0, total_sd_RT)
acquaintance_pred_RT <- acquaintance_fixed_RT + rnorm(n_samples, 0, total_sd_RT)

distribution_data_RT_full <- data.frame(
  Identity = rep(c("NonPerson", "Stranger", "Celebrity", "Acquaintance", "Close"), each = n_samples),
  Predicted_Value = c(nonperson_pred_RT, stranger_pred_RT, celebrity_pred_RT, 
                      acquaintance_pred_RT, close_pred_RT)
)

# 5. 计算箱型图数据(基于固定效应)
ci_data_RT <- data.frame(
  Identity = c("NonPerson", "Stranger", "Celebrity", "Acquaintance", "Close"),
  Mean = c(mean(nonperson_fixed_RT), mean(stranger_fixed_RT), mean(celebrity_fixed_RT),
           mean(acquaintance_fixed_RT), mean(close_fixed_RT)),
  Q25 = c(quantile(nonperson_fixed_RT, 0.25), quantile(stranger_fixed_RT, 0.25),
          quantile(celebrity_fixed_RT, 0.25), quantile(acquaintance_fixed_RT, 0.25),
          quantile(close_fixed_RT, 0.25)),
  Q75 = c(quantile(nonperson_fixed_RT, 0.75), quantile(stranger_fixed_RT, 0.75),
          quantile(celebrity_fixed_RT, 0.75), quantile(acquaintance_fixed_RT, 0.75),
          quantile(close_fixed_RT, 0.75)),
  CI_lower = c(quantile(nonperson_fixed_RT, 0.025), quantile(stranger_fixed_RT, 0.025),
               quantile(celebrity_fixed_RT, 0.025), quantile(acquaintance_fixed_RT, 0.025),
               quantile(close_fixed_RT, 0.025)),
  CI_upper = c(quantile(nonperson_fixed_RT, 0.975), quantile(stranger_fixed_RT, 0.975),
               quantile(celebrity_fixed_RT, 0.975), quantile(acquaintance_fixed_RT, 0.975),
               quantile(close_fixed_RT, 0.975))
)


print("=== RT箱型图数据 ===")
print(ci_data_RT)
```

```{r}
# ============================================
```
```{r}
# 第三部分: 绘图
# ============================================

# 颜色设置
custom_colors <- c(
  "NonPerson" = rgb(219, 49, 36, maxColorValue = 255),   # 红色
  "Stranger" = rgb(252, 140, 90, maxColorValue = 255),     # 橙色  
  "Celebrity" = rgb(255, 223, 146, maxColorValue = 255),        # 黄色
  "Acquaintance" = rgb(144, 190, 224, maxColorValue = 255),    # 浅蓝色
  "Close" = rgb(75, 116, 178, maxColorValue = 255)       # 深蓝色
)

# 选择使用哪个数据集绘图(这里使用包含随机效应的版本)
distribution_data_RT <- distribution_data_RT_fixed
distribution_data_ACC <- distribution_data_ACC_fixed

# 设置因子顺序
identity_order <- rev(c("NonPerson", "Stranger", "Celebrity", "Acquaintance", "Close"))
distribution_data_RT$Identity <- factor(distribution_data_RT$Identity, levels = identity_order)
distribution_data_ACC$Identity <- factor(distribution_data_ACC$Identity, levels = identity_order)
ci_data_RT$Identity <- factor(ci_data_RT$Identity, levels = identity_order)
ci_data_ACC$Identity <- factor(ci_data_ACC$Identity, levels = identity_order)

# 箱型图参数设置
box_height <- 0.08    # 箱体高度
box_y_offset <- 0.01  # 箱体垂直位置偏移(往下移动半个箱体高度)

# RT图
p_RT <- ggplot(distribution_data_RT, aes(x = Predicted_Value, y = Identity)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    bandwidth = 0.02,
    aes(fill = Identity),
    alpha = 0.8,
    scale = 0.8,
    color = NA
  ) +
  # 须子(whiskers): 从CI下限到25%分位数
  geom_segment(data = ci_data_RT,
               aes(x = CI_lower, xend = Q25,
                   y = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset,
                   yend = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset),
               color = "gray30",
               linewidth = 0.6,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # 须子: 从75%分位数到CI上限
  geom_segment(data = ci_data_RT,
               aes(x = Q75, xend = CI_upper,
                   y = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset,
                   yend = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset),
               color = "gray30",
               linewidth = 0.6,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # 箱体(25%-75%分位数)
  geom_rect(data = ci_data_RT,
            aes(xmin = Q25, xmax = Q75,
                ymin = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset - box_height/2,
                ymax = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset + box_height/2),
            fill = NA,
            color = "gray30",
            linewidth = 0.5,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # 中位线(均值)
  geom_segment(data = ci_data_RT,
               aes(x = Mean, xend = Mean,
                   y = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset - box_height/2,
                   yend = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset + box_height/2),
               color = "gray30",
               linewidth = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Cohen's d (Other - Self Identity) in RT",
    y = "Standardized Identity"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-0, 1), breaks = seq(-1, 2, by = 0.25)) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.title = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold", color = "black", family = "Times New Roman"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 35, color = "black", family = "Times New Roman"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA)
  )

# ACC图
p_ACC <- ggplot(distribution_data_ACC, aes(x = Predicted_Value, y = Identity)) +
  geom_density_ridges(
    bandwidth = 0.02,
    aes(fill = Identity),
    alpha = 0.8,
    scale = 0.8,
    color = NA
  ) +
  # 须子: 从CI下限到25%分位数
  geom_segment(data = ci_data_ACC,
               aes(x = CI_lower, xend = Q25,
                   y = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset,
                   yend = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset),
               color = "gray30",
               linewidth = 0.6,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # 须子: 从75%分位数到CI上限
  geom_segment(data = ci_data_ACC,
               aes(x = Q75, xend = CI_upper,
                   y = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset,
                   yend = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset),
               color = "gray30",
               linewidth = 0.6,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # 箱体(25%-75%分位数)
  geom_rect(data = ci_data_ACC,
            aes(xmin = Q25, xmax = Q75,
                ymin = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset - box_height/2,
                ymax = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset + box_height/2),
            fill = NA,
            color = "gray30",
            linewidth = 0.5,
            inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  # 中位线(均值)
  geom_segment(data = ci_data_ACC,
               aes(x = Mean, xend = Mean,
                   y = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset - box_height/2,
                   yend = as.numeric(Identity) + box_y_offset + box_height/2),
               color = "gray30",
               linewidth = 0.5,
               inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +
  labs(
    x = "Cohen's d (Self - Other Identity) in ACC",
    y = "Standardized Identity"
  ) +
```

```{r}
########################################
# MISMATCHING 的自我优势
emm_options(pbkrtest.limit = 1000000)
data_mis <- filter(data_filtered, Matching == 'Nonmatching', RT_ms >= 200)  

data_RT_mis <- filter(data_mis, ACC == 1)
data_RT_mis$Standarlized_Identity<- relevel(data_RT_mis$Standarlized_Identity, ref = "Self")


m1_RT_mis <- lme4::lmer(data = data_RT_mis, 
                        formula = RT_ms ~ Standarlized_Identity + (1|Subject) + (1|Source),
                        control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

# 过于复杂无法拟合
m1_RT_mis_v3 <- lme4::lmer(data = data_RT_mis, 
                           formula = RT_ms ~ Standarlized_Identity + (1|Subject/Source),
                           control = lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

m1_RT_mis <- as_lmerModLmerTest(m1_RT_mis)

summary(m1_RT_mis)

mis_RT_result <- emmeans(m1_RT_mis, pairwise~Standarlized_Identity, adjust = "Tukey") 

m1_ACC_mis <- lme4::glmer(data = data_mis, 
                          formula = ACC ~ Standarlized_Identity + (1|Subject), # 若加入Source随机截距无法拟合
                          family = binomial(link = "logit"),  # 关键：指定二项分布和logit链接
                          control = glmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa"))

# 将Standarlized_Identity列除Self全转换成Other
# 然后根据Matching列与Standarlized_Identity计算不同被试的平均反应时与正确率

sub_self_other <- data_filtered %>%
  mutate(
    Identity_binary = ifelse(Standarlized_Identity == "Self", "Self", "Other")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Subject, Matching, Identity_binary) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_RT_ms = mean(RT_ms[ACC == 1], na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ACC = mean(ACC, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_trials = n(),
    sd_RT_ms = sd(RT_ms, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_ACC = sd(ACC, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 计算不同Matching条件下，Self与Other在反应时与正确率的差值，反应时oth - self 正确率 self - oth
difference_scores <- sub_self_other %>%
  select(Subject, Matching, Identity_binary, mean_RT_ms, mean_ACC) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Identity_binary,
    values_from = c(mean_RT_ms, mean_ACC),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Other平均反应时 - Self平均反应时
    RT_diff_Other_minus_Self = mean_RT_ms_Other - mean_RT_ms_Self,
    
    # Self平均正确率 - Other平均正确率  
    ACC_diff_Self_minus_Other = mean_ACC_Self - mean_ACC_Other
  ) %>%
  select(Subject, Matching, RT_diff_Other_minus_Self, ACC_diff_Self_minus_Other,
         # 保留原始值便于检查
         mean_RT_ms_Self, mean_RT_ms_Other, mean_ACC_Self, mean_ACC_Other)

wide_difference_scores <- difference_scores %>%
  select(Subject, Matching, RT_diff_Other_minus_Self, ACC_diff_Self_minus_Other) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Matching,
    values_from = c(RT_diff_Other_minus_Self, ACC_diff_Self_minus_Other),
    names_sep = "_"
  )

cor_RT <-cor.test(wide_difference_scores$RT_diff_Other_minus_Self_Matching, 
                  wide_difference_scores$RT_diff_Other_minus_Self_Nonmatching)
```

```{r}
# 重新命名列以匹配需求
colnames(data) <- c("rt_self", "rt_close", "rt_stranger", "rt_non_person", "rt_acquaintance", 
                    "cohens_d_self_close", "cohens_d_self_stranger", "cohens_d_self_non_person", "cohens_d_self_acquaintance")

# 计算 RT 差值
data$SA_RT <- data$rt_self - data$rt_acquaintance
data$SC_RT <- data$rt_self - data$rt_close
data$SS_RT <- data$rt_self - data$rt_stranger
data$SN_RT <- data$rt_self - data$rt_non_person

# 定义 geom_flat_violin
"%||%" <- function(a, b) { if (!is.null(a)) a else b }

geom_flat_violin <- function(mapping = NULL, data = NULL, stat = "ydensity",
                             position = "dodge", trim = TRUE, scale = "area",
                             show.legend = NA, inherit.aes = TRUE, ...) {
  layer(
    data = data,
    mapping = mapping,
    stat = stat,
    geom = GeomFlatViolin,
    position = position,
    show.legend = show.legend,
    inherit.aes = inherit.aes,
    params = list(
      trim = trim,
      scale = scale,
      ...
    )
  )
}

GeomFlatViolin <- ggproto("GeomFlatViolin", Geom,
                          setup_data = function(data, params) {
                            data$width <- data$width %||%
                              params$width %||% (resolution(data$x, FALSE) * 0.9)
                            
                            data %>%
                              group_by(group) %>%
                              mutate(ymin = min(y),
                                     ymax = max(y),
                                     xmin = x,
                                     xmax = x + width / 2)
                          },
                          draw_group = function(data, panel_scales, coord) {
                            data <- transform(data, xminv = x,
                                              xmaxv = x + violinwidth * (xmax - x))
                            newdata <- rbind(plyr::arrange(transform(data, x = xminv), y),
                                             plyr::arrange(transform(data, x = xmaxv), -y))
                            newdata <- rbind(newdata, newdata[1,])
                            ggplot2:::ggname("geom_flat_violin", GeomPolygon$draw_panel(newdata, panel_scales, coord))
                          },
                          draw_key = draw_key_polygon,
                          default_aes = aes(weight = 1, colour = "grey20", fill = "white", size = 0.5,
                                            alpha = NA, linetype = "solid"),
                          required_aes = c("x", "y")
)

raincloud_theme <- theme(
  text = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.title.x = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.title.y = element_text(size = 16),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
  axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
  legend.position = "right",
  plot.title = element_text(lineheight = .8, face = "bold", size = 16),
  panel.border = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
  panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
  axis.line.x = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 0.5, linetype = 'solid'),
  axis.line.y = element_line(colour = 'black', size = 0.5, linetype = 'solid')
)

# 画图函数
generate_plot <- function(x_var, y_var, x_label, y_label, title) {
  ggplot(data, aes_string(x = x_var, y = y_var)) +
    geom_point(color = "blue", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, outlier.shape = NA) +
    geom_flat_violin(aes(fill = ..density..), scale = "width", trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "red", se = TRUE) +
    theme_minimal() +
    raincloud_theme +
    labs(x = x_label, y = y_label, title = title)
}

# 绘制四个图
p1.1 <- generate_plot("SA_RT", "cohens_d_self_acquaintance", "SA_RT", "Cohen's d (Self - Acquaintance)", "P1.1: RT vs. Cohen's d (Self - Acquaintance)")
p1.2 <- generate_plot("SC_RT", "cohens_d_self_close", "SC_RT", "Cohen's d (Self - Close)", "P1.2: RT vs. Cohen's d (Self - Close)")
p1.3 <- generate_plot("SS_RT", "cohens_d_self_stranger", "SS_RT", "Cohen's d (Self - Stranger)", "P1.3: RT vs. Cohen's d (Self - Stranger)")
p1.4 <- generate_plot("SN_RT", "cohens_d_self_non_person", "SN_RT", "Cohen's d (Self - Non-Person)", "P1.4: RT vs. Cohen's d (Self - Non-Person)")

# 显示所有图形
library(gridExtra)
```

```{r}
##### 随样本量增加的mismatch的作为优势效应量检验   

# 读取数据
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(effsize)

set.seed(990102)

# =============================================================================
# bootstrap 2.0
# =============================================================================

bootstrap_analysis_simple <- function(cohens_d_result, condition_name, n_bootstrap = 500) {
  
  if(is.list(cohens_d_result) && "individual_results" %in% names(cohens_d_result)) {
    cohend_data <- cohens_d_result$individual_results
  } else {
    cohend_data <- cohens_d_result
  }
  
  if(is.null(cohend_data) || nrow(cohend_data) == 0) {
    warning(paste("没有", condition_name, "的Cohen's d数据"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cohend_clean <- cohend_data[!is.na(cohend_data$Cohens_d), ]
  
  if(nrow(cohend_clean) == 0) {
    warning(paste(condition_name, "没有有效的Cohen's d值"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # 样本量序列生成：从10开始，步长为10，直到最大样本量
  max_n <- nrow(cohend_clean)
  if(max_n < 10) {
    warning(paste(condition_name, "样本量太小（少于10），无法进行Bootstrap分析"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # 从10开始，步长为10，直到最大样本量
  sample_sizes <- seq(from = 10, to = max_n, by = 10)
  
  # 确保包含最大样本量（如果不是10的倍数）
  if(max_n %% 10 != 0) {
    sample_sizes <- c(sample_sizes, max_n)
  }
  
  sample_sizes <- unique(sort(sample_sizes))
  
  # 获取所有被试的Cohen's d值
  all_cohens_d <- cohend_clean$Cohens_d
  
  # Bootstrap分析
  boot_results <- list()
  
  cat(paste("开始", condition_name, "的Bootstrap分析...\n"))
  
  for (n in sample_sizes) {
    if (n > length(all_cohens_d)) next
    if (n < 10) next
    
    cat(paste("  样本量", n, "- 进行", n_bootstrap, "次有放回抽样...\n"))
    
    # 进行n_bootstrap次有放回抽样
    bootstrap_means <- replicate(n_bootstrap, {
      # 从所有被试中有放回地抽取n个被试
      sampled_cohens_d <- sample(all_cohens_d, size = n, replace = TRUE)
      # 直接计算这n个Cohen's d的平均值
      mean(sampled_cohens_d)
    })
    
    # 计算bootstrap结果的统计量
    boot_results[[length(boot_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      SampleSize = n,
      Identity = condition_name,
      Mean_d = mean(bootstrap_means),
      SE = sd(bootstrap_means),
      CI_lower = quantile(bootstrap_means, 0.025),
      CI_upper = quantile(bootstrap_means, 0.975),
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if(length(boot_results) > 0) {
    final_data <- bind_rows(boot_results)
    cat(paste(condition_name, "Bootstrap分析完成，共", nrow(final_data), "个样本量点\n"))
    return(final_data)
  } else {
    warning(paste(condition_name, "Bootstrap分析失败"))
    return(NULL)
  }
}

# 合并Bootstrap结果 - 使用简化的函数
combined_bootstrap_analysis_simple <- function(shape_result, label_result, n_bootstrap = 500) {
  
  cat("=== 开始简化的Bootstrap分析 ===\n")
  cat(paste("每个样本量将进行", n_bootstrap, "次有放回抽样\n"))
  cat("每次抽样直接计算平均Cohen's d\n\n")
  
  shape_bootstrap <- bootstrap_analysis_simple(shape_result, "Shape", n_bootstrap)
  label_bootstrap <- bootstrap_analysis_simple(label_result, "Label", n_bootstrap)
  
  # 合并有效结果
  valid_results <- list()
  if(!is.null(shape_bootstrap)) valid_results <- c(valid_results, list(shape_bootstrap))
  if(!is.null(label_bootstrap)) valid_results <- c(valid_results, list(label_bootstrap))
  
  if(length(valid_results) == 0) {
    warning("没有有效的Bootstrap结果")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  combined_results <- bind_rows(valid_results)
  
  if(nrow(combined_results) > 0) {
    combined_results$is_significant <- combined_results$CI_lower > 0
  }
  
  return(combined_results)
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 绘图函数
# =============================================================================

create_bootstrap_plot <- function(combined_results, measure = "RT") {
  
  if(is.null(combined_results) || nrow(combined_results) == 0) {
    cat("没有数据可绘图\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  identity_colors <- c("Shape" = "#2E86AB", "Label" = "#A23B72")
  
  # 根据测量类型设置标题和Y轴标签
  if(measure == "RT") {
    y_label <- "Cohen's d (Stranger - Self)"
    title <- "Bootstrap Power Analysis of Reaction Time"
  } else {
    y_label <- "Cohen's d (Self - Stranger)"  
    title <- "Bootstrap Power Analysis of Accuracy"
  }
  
  p <- ggplot(combined_results, aes(x = SampleSize, y = Mean_d, color = Identity, fill = Identity)) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 2.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50", alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_color_manual(values = identity_colors) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = identity_colors) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02)),
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01)),
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)
    ) +
    labs(
      x = "Sample Size (Number of Participants)",
      y = y_label,
      color = "Social Identity Category",
      fill = "Social Identity Category",
      title = title
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold", family = "Times New Roman"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 35, family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 35, face = "bold", color = "black", 
                                  family = "Times New Roman", margin = margin(t = 20)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 35, color = "black", face = "bold", 
                                  family = "Times New Roman", angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 20)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 35, color = "black", family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.7),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 35, hjust = 0.5, family = "Times New Roman")
    )
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 主分析流程 - 使用简化的bootstrap方法
# =============================================================================

run_complete_analysis_simple <- function(data_filtered, data_rt_mis, save_plots = TRUE, 
                                         n_bootstrap = 500) {
  
  cat("=== 开始简化的RT和ACC分析 ===\n")
  cat("重要：RT分析会自动筛选正确试次，ACC分析使用所有试次\n")
  cat(paste("每个样本量将进行", n_bootstrap, "次有放回抽样（只在被试层面）\n\n"))
  
  results <- list()
  
  # RT分析
  cat("第一步：反应时间分析\n")
  tryCatch({
    cat("处理RT Shape数据...\n")
    rt_shape_data <- process_data(data_rt_mis, "Shape")  
    cat("处理RT Label数据...\n")
    rt_label_data <- process_data(data_rt_mis, "Label")
    
    cat("计算RT Cohen's d...\n")
    rt_shape_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(rt_shape_data, "Shape", "RT")
    rt_label_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(rt_label_data, "Label", "RT") 
    
    cat("RT 简化Bootstrap分析...\n")
    rt_bootstrap <- combined_bootstrap_analysis_simple(rt_shape_cohens, rt_label_cohens, n_bootstrap)
    rt_plot <- create_bootstrap_plot(rt_bootstrap, "RT")
    
    results$rt_plot <- rt_plot
    results$rt_bootstrap <- rt_bootstrap
    results$rt_shape_cohens <- rt_shape_cohens
    results$rt_label_cohens <- rt_label_cohens
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("RT分析失败:", e$message))
  })
  
  # ACC分析  
  cat("\n第二步：准确率分析\n")
  tryCatch({
    cat("处理ACC Shape数据...\n")
    acc_shape_data <- process_data(data_filtered, "Shape")
    cat("处理ACC Label数据...\n")
    acc_label_data <- process_data(data_filtered, "Label")
    
    cat("计算ACC Cohen's d...\n")
    acc_shape_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(acc_shape_data, "Shape", "ACC")
    acc_label_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(acc_label_data, "Label", "ACC")
    
    cat("ACC 简化Bootstrap分析...\n")
    acc_bootstrap <- combined_bootstrap_analysis_simple(acc_shape_cohens, acc_label_cohens, n_bootstrap)
    acc_plot <- create_bootstrap_plot(acc_bootstrap, "ACC")
    
    results$acc_plot <- acc_plot
    results$acc_bootstrap <- acc_bootstrap
    results$acc_shape_cohens <- acc_shape_cohens
    results$acc_label_cohens <- acc_label_cohens
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("ACC分析失败:", e$message))
  })
  
  # 显示和保存图形
  cat("\n第三步：显示和保存结果\n")
  if(!is.null(results$rt_plot)) {
    print(results$rt_plot)
    if(save_plots) {
      ggsave("Bootstrap_RT_Analysis_Simple.pdf", results$rt_plot, 
             width = 12, height = 8, device = "pdf")
      cat("RT图已保存为PDF\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("RT图生成失败\n")
  }
  
  if(!is.null(results$acc_plot)) {
    print(results$acc_plot)
    if(save_plots) {
      ggsave("Bootstrap_ACC_Analysis_Simple.pdf", results$acc_plot, 
             width = 12, height = 8, device = "pdf")
      cat("ACC图已保存为PDF\n")
    }
  } else {
    cat("ACC图生成失败\n")
  }
  
  # 结果总结
  cat("\n=== 简化分析完成 ===\n")
  if(!is.null(results$rt_shape_cohens) && !is.na(results$rt_shape_cohens$mean_cohens_d)) {
    cat("RT Shape Cohen's d平均值:", round(results$rt_shape_cohens$mean_cohens_d, 4), "\n")
  }
  if(!is.null(results$rt_label_cohens) && !is.na(results$rt_label_cohens$mean_cohens_d)) {
    cat("RT Label Cohen's d平均值:", round(results$rt_label_cohens$mean_cohens_d, 4), "\n")
  }
  if(!is.null(results$acc_shape_cohens) && !is.na(results$acc_shape_cohens$mean_cohens_d)) {
    cat("ACC Shape Cohen's d平均值:", round(results$acc_shape_cohens$mean_cohens_d, 4), "\n")
  }
  if(!is.null(results$acc_label_cohens) && !is.na(results$acc_label_cohens$mean_cohens_d)) {
    cat("ACC Label Cohen's d平均值:", round(results$acc_label_cohens$mean_cohens_d, 4), "\n")
  }
  
  return(results)
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 真正的统计功效分析 - 模拟小样本看不到效应，大样本能看到
# =============================================================================

power_analysis_simulation <- function(cohens_d_result, condition_name, 
                                      n_simulations = 500, alpha = 0.05) {
  
  if(is.list(cohens_d_result) && "individual_results" %in% names(cohens_d_result)) {
    cohend_data <- cohens_d_result$individual_results
  } else {
    cohend_data <- cohens_d_result
  }
  
  if(is.null(cohend_data) || nrow(cohend_data) == 0) {
    warning(paste("没有", condition_name, "的Cohen's d数据"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  cohend_clean <- cohend_data[!is.na(cohend_data$Cohens_d), ]
  
  if(nrow(cohend_clean) == 0) {
    warning(paste(condition_name, "没有有效的Cohen's d值"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # 获取总体参数
  all_cohens_d <- cohend_clean$Cohens_d
  population_mean <- mean(all_cohens_d)
  population_sd <- sd(all_cohens_d)
  
  cat(paste("\n", condition_name, "的总体参数:\n"))
  cat(paste("  Cohen's d均值:", round(population_mean, 4), "\n"))
  cat(paste("  Cohen's d标准差:", round(population_sd, 4), "\n"))
  
  # 样本量序列
  max_n <- length(all_cohens_d)
  if(max_n < 10) {
    warning(paste(condition_name, "样本量太小"))
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  sample_sizes <- seq(from = 10, to = min(max_n, 200), by = 10)
  if(max(sample_sizes) < max_n && max_n <= 200) {
    sample_sizes <- c(sample_sizes, max_n)
  }
  sample_sizes <- unique(sort(sample_sizes))
  
  # 功效分析
  power_results <- list()
  
  cat(paste("开始", condition_name, "的功效分析...\n"))
  
  for (n in sample_sizes) {
    cat(paste("  样本量", n, "...\n"))
    
    # 模拟n_simulations次研究
    sim_results <- replicate(n_simulations, {
      # 从总体中有放回抽取n个被试
      sampled_cohens_d <- sample(all_cohens_d, size = n, replace = TRUE)
      
      # 计算统计量
      sample_mean <- mean(sampled_cohens_d)
      sample_se <- sd(sampled_cohens_d) / sqrt(n)
      
      # 单样本t检验（检验均值是否显著大于0）
      t_stat <- sample_mean / sample_se
      p_value <- pt(t_stat, df = n - 1, lower.tail = FALSE)
      
      # 计算置信区间
      ci_lower <- sample_mean - qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sample_se
      ci_upper <- sample_mean + qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * sample_se
      
      # 返回结果
      c(
        mean = sample_mean,
        se = sample_se,
        ci_lower = ci_lower,
        ci_upper = ci_upper,
        p_value = p_value,
        significant = p_value < alpha
      )
    })
    
    # 汇总结果
    power_results[[length(power_results) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      SampleSize = n,
      Identity = condition_name,
      Mean_d = mean(sim_results["mean", ]),
      SE = mean(sim_results["se", ]),
      CI_lower = mean(sim_results["ci_lower", ]),
      CI_upper = mean(sim_results["ci_upper", ]),
      Power = mean(sim_results["significant", ]),  # 统计功效
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
  }
  
  if(length(power_results) > 0) {
    final_data <- bind_rows(power_results)
    cat(paste(condition_name, "功效分析完成\n"))
    return(final_data)
  } else {
    warning(paste(condition_name, "功效分析失败"))
    return(NULL)
  }
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 功效分析的可视化
# =============================================================================

create_power_plot <- function(power_results, measure = "RT") {
  
  if(is.null(power_results) || nrow(power_results) == 0) {
    cat("没有功效数据可绘图\n")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  identity_colors <- c("Shape" = "#2E86AB", "Label" = "#A23B72")
  
  if(measure == "RT") {
    y_label <- "Cohen's d (Stranger - Self)"
    title <- "Statistical Power Analysis of Reaction Time"
  } else {
    y_label <- "Cohen's d (Self - Stranger)"  
    title <- "Statistical Power Analysis of Accuracy"
  }
  
  # 创建主图 - Cohen's d随样本量变化
  p1 <- ggplot(power_results, aes(x = SampleSize, y = Mean_d, 
                                  color = Identity, fill = Identity)) +
    # 置信区间
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = CI_lower, ymax = CI_upper), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
    
    # 零线
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "gray30", linewidth = 0.8) +
    
    # 主线和点
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
    geom_point(size = 3.5) +
    
    # 根据功效着色点
    geom_point(data = filter(power_results, Power >= 0.8), 
               aes(x = SampleSize, y = Mean_d), 
               size = 5, alpha = 0.3, shape = 16) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = identity_colors, name = "Social Identity Category") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = identity_colors, name = "Social Identity Category") +
    
    scale_y_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.05)),
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 8)
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02)),
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)
    ) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Sample Size (Number of Participants)",
      y = y_label,
      title = title,
      subtitle = "Highlighted points: Statistical Power ≥ 80%"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", family = "Times New Roman"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 24, family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold", color = "black", 
                                  family = "Times New Roman", margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32, color = "black", face = "bold", 
                                  family = "Times New Roman", margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 28, color = "black", family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 32, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", 
                                family = "Times New Roman"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5, family = "Times New Roman", 
                                   color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 10))
    )
  
  # 创建功效曲线图
  p2 <- ggplot(power_results, aes(x = SampleSize, y = Power, color = Identity)) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, linetype = "dashed", color = "red", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
    geom_point(size = 3.5) +
    
    # 标注80%功效的点
    geom_point(data = filter(power_results, Power >= 0.8), 
               aes(x = SampleSize, y = Power), 
               size = 5, alpha = 0.4, shape = 16) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = identity_colors, name = "Social Identity Category") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, 1),
      breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.2),
      labels = scales::percent_format()
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.02)),
      breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)
    ) +
    
    labs(
      x = "Sample Size (Number of Participants)",
      y = "Statistical Power (1 - β)",
      title = paste("Power Curve -", ifelse(measure == "RT", "Reaction Time", "Accuracy")),
      subtitle = "Red dashed line: 80% power (conventional threshold)"
    ) +
    
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "top",
      legend.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold", family = "Times New Roman"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 24, family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.title.x = element_text(size = 32, face = "bold", color = "black", 
                                  family = "Times New Roman", margin = margin(t = 15)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(size = 32, color = "black", face = "bold", 
                                  family = "Times New Roman", margin = margin(r = 15)),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 28, color = "black", family = "Times New Roman"),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.8),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "gray90", linewidth = 0.3),
      panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 32, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", 
                                family = "Times New Roman"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 22, hjust = 0.5, family = "Times New Roman", 
                                   color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 10))
    )
  
  return(list(effect_plot = p1, power_curve = p2))
}
```

```{r}
# =============================================================================
# 综合分析函数
# =============================================================================

run_power_analysis <- function(data_filtered, data_rt_mis, save_plots = TRUE, 
                               n_simulations = 500) {
  
  cat("=== 开始统计功效分析 ===\n")
  cat(paste("每个样本量将进行", n_simulations, "次模拟研究\n\n"))
  
  results <- list()
  
  # RT分析
  cat("第一步：反应时间功效分析\n")
  tryCatch({
    rt_shape_data <- process_data(data_rt_mis, "Shape")  
    rt_label_data <- process_data(data_rt_mis, "Label")
    
    rt_shape_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(rt_shape_data, "Shape", "RT")
    rt_label_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(rt_label_data, "Label", "RT")
    
    # Shape功效分析
    rt_shape_power <- power_analysis_simulation(rt_shape_cohens, "Shape", n_simulations)
    rt_label_power <- power_analysis_simulation(rt_label_cohens, "Label", n_simulations)
    
    # 合并结果
    if(!is.null(rt_shape_power) && !is.null(rt_label_power)) {
      rt_power_combined <- bind_rows(rt_shape_power, rt_label_power)
      rt_plots <- create_power_plot(rt_power_combined, "RT")
      
      results$rt_effect_plot <- rt_plots$effect_plot
      results$rt_power_curve <- rt_plots$power_curve
      results$rt_power_data <- rt_power_combined
      
      if(save_plots) {
        ggsave("Power_RT_Effect.pdf", rt_plots$effect_plot, 
               width = 14, height = 9, device = "pdf")
        ggsave("Power_RT_Curve.pdf", rt_plots$power_curve, 
               width = 14, height = 9, device = "pdf")
        cat("RT功效分析图已保存\n")
      }
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("RT功效分析失败:", e$message))
  })
  
  # ACC分析
  cat("\n第二步：准确率功效分析\n")
  tryCatch({
    acc_shape_data <- process_data(data_filtered, "Shape")
    acc_label_data <- process_data(data_filtered, "Label")
    
    acc_shape_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(acc_shape_data, "Shape", "ACC")
    acc_label_cohens <- calculate_cohens_d(acc_label_data, "Label", "ACC")
    
    # 功效分析
    acc_shape_power <- power_analysis_simulation(acc_shape_cohens, "Shape", n_simulations)
    acc_label_power <- power_analysis_simulation(acc_label_cohens, "Label", n_simulations)
    
    # 合并结果
    if(!is.null(acc_shape_power) && !is.null(acc_label_power)) {
      acc_power_combined <- bind_rows(acc_shape_power, acc_label_power)
      acc_plots <- create_power_plot(acc_power_combined, "ACC")
      
      results$acc_effect_plot <- acc_plots$effect_plot
      results$acc_power_curve <- acc_plots$power_curve
      results$acc_power_data <- acc_power_combined
      
      if(save_plots) {
        ggsave("Power_ACC_Effect.pdf", acc_plots$effect_plot, 
               width = 14, height = 9, device = "pdf")
        ggsave("Power_ACC_Curve.pdf", acc_plots$power_curve, 
               width = 14, height = 9, device = "pdf")
        cat("ACC功效分析图已保存\n")
      }
    }
    
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning(paste("ACC功效分析失败:", e$message))
  })
  
  cat("\n=== 功效分析完成 ===\n")
  
  return(results)
}

```

```{r}
filter_valid_subjects <- function(data, identity_column) {
  
  # 使用标准的dplyr语法，避免!!sym()的问题
  subject_summary <- data %>%
    group_by(Subject) %>%
    summarise(
      unique_identities = if(identity_column == "Standarlized_Identity") {
        list(unique(Standarlized_Identity[!is.na(Standarlized_Identity)]))
      } else {
        list(unique(Label_Identity[!is.na(Label_Identity)]))
      },
      identity_count = if(identity_column == "Standarlized_Identity") {
        length(unique(Standarlized_Identity[!is.na(Standarlized_Identity)]))
      } else {
        length(unique(Label_Identity[!is.na(Label_Identity)]))
      },
      has_self = if(identity_column == "Standarlized_Identity") {
        any(Standarlized_Identity == "Self", na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        any(Label_Identity == "Self", na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      has_stranger = if(identity_column == "Standarlized_Identity") {
        any(Standarlized_Identity == "Stranger", na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        any(Label_Identity == "Stranger", na.rm = TRUE)
      },
      total_trials = n(),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      meets_criteria = has_self & has_stranger & identity_count >= 3
    )
  
  valid_subjects <- subject_summary$Subject[subject_summary$meets_criteria]
  print(paste("保留的被试数量:", length(valid_subjects)))
  
  return(valid_subjects)
}
```


```{r}
# 通用的数据处理函数
process_data <- function(data, analysis_type = "Shape") {
  
  # 筛选被试
  if(analysis_type == "Shape") {
    valid_subjects <- filter_valid_subjects(data, "Standarlized_Identity")
  } else {
    valid_subjects <- filter_valid_subjects(data, "Label_Identity")
  }
  
  # 处理数据
  if(analysis_type == "Shape") {
    data_processed <- data %>%
      filter(Subject %in% valid_subjects) %>%
      mutate(
        Primary = case_when(
          Standarlized_Identity == "Self" ~ "Self",
          Standarlized_Identity == "Stranger" ~ "Stranger", 
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        Secondary = case_when(
          Label_Identity == "Self" ~ "Self",
          Label_Identity == "Stranger" ~ "Stranger",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(
        Primary == "Self" |
          (Primary == "Stranger" & Secondary != "Self") |
          Primary == "Other"
      )
  } else {
    data_processed <- data %>%
      filter(Subject %in% valid_subjects) %>%
      mutate(
        Primary = case_when(
          Label_Identity == "Self" ~ "Self",
          Label_Identity == "Stranger" ~ "Stranger", 
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        ),
        Secondary = case_when(
          Standarlized_Identity == "Self" ~ "Self",
          Standarlized_Identity == "Stranger" ~ "Stranger",
          TRUE ~ "Other"
        )
      ) %>%
      filter(
        Primary == "Self" |
          (Primary == "Stranger" & Secondary != "Self") |
          Primary == "Other"
      )
  }
  
  return(data_processed)
}

# =============================================================================
# Cohen's d 计算函数
# =============================================================================

calculate_cohens_d <- function(data, analysis_type = "Shape", measure = "RT", min_trials = 2) {
  
  # RT分析需要log转换
  if(measure == "RT") {
    if(!"log_RT_ms" %in% names(data)) {
      data$log_RT_ms <- log(data$RT_ms)
    }
    dependent_var <- "log_RT_ms"
  } else {
    dependent_var <- "ACC"
    min_trials <- 5  # ACC需要更多试次
  }
  
  # 筛选数据
  data_analysis <- data %>%
    filter(Primary %in% c("Self", "Stranger"))
  
  # 检查被试数据完整性
  subject_check <- data_analysis %>%
    group_by(Subject) %>%
    summarise(
      has_self = any(Primary == "Self"),
      has_stranger = any(Primary == "Stranger"), 
      n_self = sum(Primary == "Self"),
      n_stranger = sum(Primary == "Stranger"),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      complete_data = has_self & has_stranger & n_self >= min_trials & n_stranger >= min_trials
    )
  
  complete_subjects <- subject_check$Subject[subject_check$complete_data]
  print(paste("参与Cohen's d计算的被试数量:", length(complete_subjects)))
  
  if(length(complete_subjects) == 0) {
    warning("没有被试满足条件！")
    return(list(individual_results = data.frame(), mean_cohens_d = NA))
  }
  
  # 计算Cohen's d
  cohens_d_results <- data.frame()
  
  for(subject_id in complete_subjects) {
    subject_data <- data_analysis[data_analysis$Subject == subject_id, ]
    
    self_data <- subject_data[subject_data$Primary == "Self", dependent_var]
    stranger_data <- subject_data[subject_data$Primary == "Stranger", dependent_var]
    
    # 移除NA值
    self_data <- self_data[!is.na(self_data)]
    stranger_data <- stranger_data[!is.na(stranger_data)]
    
    tryCatch({
      # RT: Stranger - Self; ACC: Self - Stranger
      if(measure == "RT") {
        cohens_d_value <- cohen.d(stranger_data, self_data)$estimate
      } else {
        cohens_d_value <- cohen.d(self_data, stranger_data)$estimate  
      }
      
      cohens_d_results <- rbind(cohens_d_results, data.frame(
        Subject = subject_id,
        Cohens_d = cohens_d_value,
        n_self = length(self_data),
        n_stranger = length(stranger_data),
        mean_self = mean(self_data),
        mean_stranger = mean(stranger_data),
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      ))
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning(paste("被试", subject_id, "计算失败:", e$message))
    })
  }
  
  if(nrow(cohens_d_results) > 0) {
    mean_cohens_d <- mean(cohens_d_results$Cohens_d, na.rm = TRUE)
    print(paste(analysis_type, measure, "Cohen's d平均值:", round(mean_cohens_d, 4)))
  } else {
    mean_cohens_d <- NA
    print(paste(analysis_type, measure, "没有成功计算Cohen's d"))
  }
  
  return(list(
    individual_results = cohens_d_results,
    mean_cohens_d = mean_cohens_d
  ))
}
```
